task: Lane B: cache parsed /etc/projects and /etc/projid mappings in internal/quota using stat-validated cache to eliminate O(N^2) file reads across PV reconciles.

events.summary: Scope: package-level parsed mapping cache in internal/quota (stat-keyed via Dev, Ino, Size, mtime ns, ctime ns with syscall.Stat_t on linux/darwin), invalidation on package writes (AppendToFile, writeFileSynced, RemoveLineFromFile, RecoverProjectFile), exact error semantics preserved in ReadProjectsFile/ReadProjidFile and readColonMapping, immutability via returned copies, AppendToFile line scan preserved, escape hatch NFS_QUOTA_DISABLE_MAPPING_CACHE=1, decision D1 documented. Not touched: quota logic, argv construction, RBAC, hashProjectName, or other packages.

Reproduction: go test -run ^$ -bench BenchmarkWatchPVsEventStorm -benchtime=1x -count=1 ./internal/agent/ on origin/main baseline took 37.50 ms/pv (100 PVs), 34.93 ms/pv (500 PVs), 61.90 ms/pv (1000 PVs, 61.90s), and FAILED at 2000 PVs with 'not done within absolute cap 2m0s (progress {applied:1706 evenModified:851 reconcileTotal:1702 queueDepth:300})' due to O(N^2) disk read volume (~810 MB read).

Bug fix: implemented package-level stat-validated cache in internal/quota/mapping_cache.go keyed by absolute filename with syscall.Stat_t checking device, inode, size, mtime ns, and ctime ns; wired into ReadProjectsFile, ReadProjidFile, and readColonMapping with shallow-copy returns; immediate invalidation in AppendToFile and writeFileSynced.

go test -v ./internal/quota/ PASS; go test -race ./internal/quota/ ./internal/agent/ PASS; make verify PASS (fmt-check, vet, all package tests, 83 CI governance self-tests); 7 dedicated unit and concurrency tests in TestMappingCache_* PASS with zero race conditions.
events.scope: internal/quota mapping cache operations, file write invalidations, error semantics preservation, copy immutability, and -race concurrency

events.summary: BenchmarkWatchPVsEventStorm passed all tiers: pvs=100 in 3.31s (33.11 ms/pv), pvs=500 in 12.02s (24.04 ms/pv), pvs=1000 in 36.44s (36.44 ms/pv vs 61.90s before, 41% speedup), pvs=2000 in 63.07s (31.54 ms/pv, 2002 reconciles/op vs timed-out failure before) on macOS arm64, restoring linear controller pipeline throughput under event storms.
events.scope: Controller event-storm pipeline scalability and throughput across 100-2000 PVs with parsed mapping cache
